Topic: Cohort-tenure mixing is the real confound
Technical (chapter.md): Loop B Observe: calendar-day is what dashboards show; the confound is not calendar time but that each day mixes users at different per-user exposure-tenures.

Topic: Days-since-exposure tail is a survival sample
Technical (chapter.md): Loop B Observe: late-arriving users cannot reach the long-exposure tail, so day-30-of-exposure contains only early arrivers. If early arrivers differ (eager adopters), the tail mis-estimates the asymptote. Missing-data problem, not SUTVA.

Topic: Exposure-count bins weight by heavy users
Technical (chapter.md): Loop B Observe: exposure count is a function of arrival rate; heavy users dominate high-count bins. Simulator uses uniform arrival so it does not bite, but production data conflates habituation with baseline differences.

Topic: No single right view
